flows:
Navigate to https://app.uniswap.org/swap then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
On the Uniswap app swap page, click the token drop-down for the token you are selling (the top 'Sell' field) to open the token selector.
Confirm a token list opens.
Select any token from the list (for example 'ETH') as the token to bridge.
Confirm that token is now shown in the top field.
Then click the token drop-down again to reopen the token and network selection.
Never press 'Swap', 'Review', 'Confirm Swap', 'Approve', or 'Connect wallet'.
Assert that a token selection list is visible again, showing token names such as the one you chose, along with network options or a network selector.
